verdict.rationale: iTerm2's generative AI features are an optional plugin you must install separately (iterm2-docs-15) and were described as opt-in and inactive by default (iterm2-comm-1, iterm2-comm-3). Users can therefore keep terminal data away from AI providers by not enabling them. However, users reported that any text in the API-key field activated sending data to OpenAI (iterm2-comm-2), and nothing addresses how data is handled once sent. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or data-use statement, documented controls over provider training/retention, and independent verification of what data leaves the machine.
